name: Lucky Stars
source:
You’ve become the manager of a rock band of furry bad boys called Lucky. They’re notorious for being difficult to work with. Can you handle them?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你当上了兽人坏小子摇滚乐队“Lucky”的经纪人。他们向来以难以合作而臭名昭著，你有把握镇住他们吗？

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]]
